fields.title: 5 Tips to Choose the Right Flooring for Your Home
fields.summary: From tiles to hardwood and vinyl, here is how to pick a floor that balances looks, durability and budget.
fields.content:
Flooring sets the tone for your entire home, so it deserves careful thought.
Start with how each room is used — high-traffic areas like living rooms and kitchens need durable, easy-to-clean surfaces, while bedrooms can afford softer finishes.
Consider maintenance and moisture: bathrooms and kitchens do best with tiles or engineered options, while bedrooms suit wood or laminate.
Match the floor tone to your walls and furniture — lighter floors open up small spaces, darker floors add warmth and richness.
Finally, balance looks with budget. Our team helps you choose a floor that lasts and fits the way you live.
fields.author: Decora Nine

fields.title: How to Mix Prints and Patterns in Your Interiors
fields.summary: Layering patterns can feel intimidating — these simple rules make it effortless and elegant.
fields.content:
Mixing patterns is one of the fastest ways to make a space feel curated and alive.
Anchor the room with one dominant pattern, then add smaller-scale prints that share a colour.
Vary the scale — pair a large floral with a fine stripe or geometric so they complement rather than compete.
Keep a consistent colour palette to tie everything together, and use solids to give the eye a place to rest.
Done well, layered prints add personality without the clutter.
fields.author: Decora Nine

fields.title: Behind the Scenes: Our Brew Happiness Café Project
fields.summary: A look at how we turned a bare shell into a warm, industrial-chic café that keeps guests coming back.
fields.content:
When Brew Happiness approached us, they wanted a café that felt cosy yet contemporary.
We started with the layout — maximising seating while keeping a comfortable flow from counter to tables.
Custom signage, display counters and layered lighting gave the space its personality.
A mix of exposed textures and warm wood created that industrial-chic feel guests love.
The result: a café that pulls in footfall and keeps people lingering over a second cup.

fields.title: Modular Kitchen Trends for 2025
fields.summary: Handleless fronts, smart storage and warm materials — the modular kitchen ideas defining 2025.
fields.content:
The modern kitchen is more open, more tactile and smarter than ever.
Handleless, push-to-open cabinetry is leading the way for a clean, seamless look.
Smart storage — tall units, corner carousels and drawer organisers — makes every inch count.
Warm materials like wood-grain finishes and quartz counters bring balance to sleek layouts.
If you are planning a kitchen this year, these ideas are a great place to start.
fields.author: Decora Nine
fields.seo_description: Handleless fronts, smart storage and warm materials — the modular kitchen ideas defining 2025.

fields.title: Why Glass Facades Are Transforming Commercial Spaces
fields.summary: Structural glazing and ACP cladding are redefining how commercial buildings look and perform.
fields.content:
A building's facade is its first impression — and glass is making a bold statement.
Structural glass glazing floods interiors with natural light and creates a sleek, modern exterior.
Paired with ACP cladding, it delivers a seamless, low-maintenance finish that stands out at street level.
Beyond looks, a well-designed facade improves energy performance and brand perception.
It is one of our fastest-growing services for retail and commercial clients across South India.
